_memory.continuity field limits (96 chars/16 words recent_action, <=5 key_files, completion_pct rules); writer-owned packet_pointer/last_updated_at/last_updated_by; only --full-auto writes
OKF generated.at vs spec-kit last_updated_at + fingerprints; no spec-kit analogue of verified or stale_after
